def conv_flop_count(x_shape: List[int], w_shape: List[int], out_shape: List
    [int], transposed: bool=False) ->Number:
    # Extract dimensions
    if len(x_shape) == 4:  # 2D convolution
        batch_size, input_dim, h, w = x_shape
        _, output_dim, kh, kw = w_shape
        _, _, oh, ow = out_shape
        conv_dim = 2
        kernel_size = kh
        spatial_size = oh if conv_dim == 2 else ow
    elif len(x_shape) == 3:  # 1D convolution
        batch_size, input_dim, w = x_shape
        _, output_dim, kw = w_shape
        _, _, ow = out_shape
        conv_dim = 1
        kernel_size = kw
        spatial_size = ow
    elif len(x_shape) == 5:  # 3D convolution
        batch_size, input_dim, d, h, w = x_shape
        _, output_dim, kd, kh, kw = w_shape
        _, _, od, oh, ow = out_shape
        conv_dim = 3
        kernel_size = kd if conv_dim == 3 else (kh if conv_dim == 2 else kw)
        spatial_size = od if conv_dim == 3 else (oh if conv_dim == 2 else ow)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported convolution dimension")
    
    # Default group size is 1
    group_size = 1
    
    # Calculate flops
    if conv_dim == 1:
        flop = batch_size * input_dim * output_dim * kernel_size * spatial_size / group_size
    elif conv_dim == 2:
        flop = batch_size * input_dim * output_dim * kernel_size * kernel_size * spatial_size * spatial_size / group_size

        flop = batch_size * input_dim * output_dim * kernel_size * kernel_size * kernel_size * spatial_size * spatial_size * spatial_size / group_size
    
    # Convert to GFLOPs
    return flop / 1000000000.0
